domain: Wet-Lab Research Automation / Molecular Biology & NGS Automation

occupations: Medical and Clinical Laboratory Technologists and Technicians (BLS SOC 29-2010, >340,000 workers)

instruction: Transfer the 96-well PCR cooler rack onto the magnetic separation stand and engage the slide lock bar.

apparatus.cooler_rack: Chilled 96-well skirted polypropylene PCR cooler rack (127.8 x 85.5 x 28.0 mm, ANSI/SLAS standard, 110 g)
apparatus.magnetic_stand: Anodized aluminum benchtop 96-well magnetic bead separation stand (140 x 105 x 35 mm) with recessed registration nest and 96 nickel-plated neodymium ring magnet posts
apparatus.slider_lock: Prismatic sliding retaining lock bar along Y (travel 20 mm, minimum engagement 15 mm)

rubric.description: Rack resting untouched on bench staging mat
Rack lifted and transferring toward magnetic stand
Rack seated flush in magnetic registration nest, lock bar advancing
Rack seated and lock bar fully engaged (>=15 mm), hands retracted clear (>50 mm) for 20-step (1.0 s) continuous stillness hold

scoring.instantaneous_compliance: Zero permanent positive stage latching. All criteria evaluated from live physical state at each simulation step; unseating rack or retracting lock bar immediately revokes score.
